## [1.7.2](https://github.com/toidicakhia/morphe-app-patches/compare/v1.7.1...v1.7.2) (2026-11-17)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* remove Remote Desktop Manager and TeraBox patches ([ca27fff](https://github.com/toidicakhia/morphe-app-patches/commit/ca27fff))

### ✨ New Features

* **vtvgo:** sync the settings button with the exact control bar state ([5c63afd](https://github.com/toidicakhia/morphe-app-patches/commit/5c63afd))
* **vtvgo:** track player layout changes for the settings button ([fe13840](https://github.com/toidicakhia/morphe-app-patches/commit/fe13840))
* **vtvgo:** sync quality menu with player state ([757a3e3](https://github.com/toidicakhia/morphe-app-patches/commit/757a3e3))
* **vtvgo:** add video quality settings button ([bc16a72](https://github.com/toidicakhia/morphe-app-patches/commit/bc16a72))
* **devolutions:** add Skip Age Verification patch ([7de5f63](https://github.com/toidicakhia/morphe-app-patches/commit/7de5f63))
* **locket:** add Unlock Locket Gold patch ([72fc89e](https://github.com/toidicakhia/morphe-app-patches/commit/72fc89e))
* **vtvgo:** add Unlock Video Quality patch ([abaf1c1](https://github.com/toidicakhia/morphe-app-patches/commit/abaf1c1))
* **devolutions:** add Faster Startup patch for Remote Desktop Manager ([cc4dec4](https://github.com/toidicakhia/morphe-app-patches/commit/cc4dec4))

patches.name: Unlock VIP
patches.description: Forces permanent professional VIP tier, removes ads and upgrade popups, bypasses PairIP.

patches.name: Unlock Plus
patches.description: Unlocks Universal Copy Plus: removes ads, upgrade prompts and the Internet permission, and bypasses the PairIP license check so the patched app starts.

patches.name: Disable Analytics / Telemetry
patches.description: Disables all Cloudflare telemetry by no-oping the analytics bundle builder and the Firebase event dispatchers.

patches.name: Disable SSL Pinning
patches.description: Bypasses OkHttp certificate pinning on Cloudflare API calls to allow TLS traffic inspection.

patches.name: Spoof WARP+ Unlimited UI
patches.description: Forces WarpPlusState to UNLIMITED on every AccountData instance by intercepting the primary constructor before the account type field is written.

patches.name: Auto claim Benefits tasks
patches.description: Presses the Benefits/Gold-center controls and shows what it clicked: the daily video chain, claimable rewards, the watch-video task and the check-in pill. Share, save, game and purchase tasks are skipped, as are disabled controls. A control that does nothing is retried later, a task that never completes is left after three tries, and the check-in page closes itself when done. Pair it with "Auto reward ads".

patches.name: Auto reward ads
patches.description: Closes a rewarded video as soon as the reward is granted, plus the native ad that follows, so completion stays server-valid and the Benefits page gets its callback. Each network is closed through its own close/skip control first, then BACK, then finish; splash ads are closed after their countdown, an ad no task asked for (interstitial, app-open) after a few seconds, and a rewarded ad that never reports a reward after 75s.

patches.name: Block ad redirects
patches.description: Rewrites the Play Store, market: and intent: URLs inside the ad SDKs and stops the hybrid WebView client from handing a page off to the store or a browser, so an auto-opening or mis-tapped ad cannot leave TeraBox and stall the automation.

patches.name: Bypass SSL pinning
patches.description: Skips TeraBox certificate pinning and hostname checks, trusts user-installed certificates and lets the WebView ignore certificate errors, so a proxy can read HTTPS.

patches.name: Spoof signature
patches.description: Reports the stock certificate and skips Play Integrity so Google login and TeraBox's anti-cheat accept the re-signed APK. Not for sets that already spoof it.

patches.name: Bypass SSL pinning
patches.description: Bypasses EZVIZ certificate pinning and hostname checks so a debugging proxy can read its HTTPS traffic. Also trusts user-installed certificates. Not selected by default.

patches.name: Bypass Signature Check
patches.description: Skips the repack signature hash check in LoadingActivity that closes the app before it can start.

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Removes banner, splash and hot open-screen ads.

patches.name: Spoofer server
patches.description: Sends Locket's API traffic (feed, profile, AI frames, captions) to a self-hosted spoofer server instead of api.locketcamera.com. Enter the server address; the app keeps using the server's own HTTPS certificate, so no DNS profile or CA install is needed. Enable the second option to route RevenueCat and Firebase Remote Config through the same server as well. Not selected by default.

options.description: Address of the spoofer server, for example https://spoofer.example. It must answer HTTPS with a certificate for this name. A scheme is optional and is assumed to be https when missing; a path is not supported.

Also sends api.revenuecat.com and firebaseremoteconfig.googleapis.com to the spoofer server, so its Gold payload and feature flags reach the app without a DNS profile. The server must answer /v1/subscribers*, /v1/receipts* and /v1/projects*. Rebuilding the app's dex files makes patching take noticeably longer.

patches.name: Unlock Locket Gold
patches.description: Makes the app treat the signed-in account as a Locket Gold subscriber, enabling the Gold-only feature gates and replacing the paywall with subscription management. Client-side only: features validated by Locket's servers still need a real subscription.

patches.name: Disable Analytics / Telemetry
patches.description: Stops WeDJ's Mobylog tracking client from uploading playback, device-connection and startup app-check events.

patches.name: Unlock Unlimited Playback
patches.description: Makes WeDJ treat the "Unlock Unlimited Playback" in-app purchase as owned. The free-version limit that stops playback after loading a few tracks is removed and the purchase entry disappears from the track browser. Use WeDJ 1.1.1.3 on Android 9-12 and 1.1.4.5 on Android 13+. Client-side only: the Play Store transaction itself is not simulated.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks all premium features.

apps.app_name: VTV Go - TV Mọi nơi, Mọi lúc

patches.name: Block Product Ad Banners
patches.description: Points the product-ad API endpoint at a non-existent path so in-app ad banners are not loaded. Best effort: ads embedded in content responses are not affected.

patches.name: Disable Analytics / Telemetry
patches.description: Disables Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Performance, stops Sentry uploads and turns off Facebook app events. The firebase_data_collection_default_enabled flag also prevents the SDKs from re-enabling collection.

patches.name: Remove Ad ID Permissions
patches.description: Removes the advertising ID, Privacy Sandbox ad-services and Play install-referrer permissions. Device identification used for device management is left untouched.

patches.name: Remove Calendar Permissions
patches.description: Removes calendar read/write permissions. Programme reminders will no longer work.

patches.name: Remove Video Ads
patches.description: Removes VTVGo pre-roll, mid-roll, welcome TVC and other VAST/IMA ads by rejecting ad requests before playback starts.

patches.name: Trust User Certificates
patches.description: Adds user-installed CA certificates to the network security config so native traffic can be inspected with a debugging proxy. Flutter's Dart HTTP stack keeps its own trust store.

patches.name: Video quality control
patches.description: Adds an on-screen settings menu for the player's video quality. Auto follows the app's own selection; the other presets override the player's quality caps.
